messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 - eu-west embeddings write 5xx spike (alerts: kv-write-err-rate, embeddings-queue-latency). Please acknowledge and post status.

Avani R: acked. I'm primary for next 2h, handing off to Mike after that. Current state: elevated 5xx from kv-store writes to eu-west-primary. Impact: regen failures for a handful of customers (~2% of requests), elevated queueing causing p99 embed latency > 3s.

Mike T: coming up to speed. Quick question - is this only write-side? reads look normal?

Avani R: reads are fine. Seems correlated with background compaction/job that ran at 03:10 UTC and then a burst of write amplification hit the replica set. Error logs show `ERR_WRITE_TIMEOUT` from kv-prim-03.

Avani R: Actions taken so far:
- Switched affected traffic to eu-west-secondary for embeddings write route (route tag `eu-west:primary->secondary`) via routing-service.
- Enabled temporary write-retry with jitter disabled (to avoid hot loops).
- Increased embeddings queue size on frontend by +20% to absorb backlog.
- Filed ticket to infra to rollback compaction job (INFRA-4521).

Mike T: saw the routing change. Verified that p50/p95 are improved but p99 still high for some sticky sessions. Might be KV cache hot keys causing tail latency.

Lia M: noted some customers still see 502s from the regen path. I patched fallback to return cached embedding results when available to avoid user-facing error. That reduces impact to ~0.5% failing requests.

Sarah L: handoff checklist for next shift (Mike will be primary):
- Who's primary: Mike T (next 2h)
- Who's secondary: Josh P (on-call if escalation)
- Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/kv-write-amplification (follow section "eviction and write-mitigations")
- Pager routing: keep eu-west pref to secondary until infra confirms compaction rolled back
- Customer comms: Lia to update status page with 'partial degradation' and list affected endpoints
- SLO watch: embeddings-regens >1% failing -> escalate to SEV-1

Josh P: I'm on standby as secondary. If p99 doesn't drop under 2s within 30m after routing change, escalate and we open a SEV-1 bridge.

Mike T: quick diagnostics I ran:
```
# tail recent kv errors
kubectl logs -n kv ns/kv-prim-03 | grep ERR_WRITE_TIMEOUT | tail -n 50
# check outstanding compaction job
curl -s http://infra-api.internal/jobs/compaction/eu-west | jq .status
```

Mike T: logs show repeated `write timeout` with `E_IO` and `backpressure=1`. I also see eviction spikes. Hypothesis: compaction + hot writes -> increased IO latency -> client-side timeouts.

Avani R: mitigation options left:
1) Fully cutover write traffic to eu-west-secondary until kv-prim-03 is healthy (affects cross-region sticky sessions; need to watch consistency window).
2) Temporarily throttle background compaction (preferred by infra) - rolling abort in progress.
3) Enable aggressive prefix caching on embeddings route for 15m to reduce writes from retries.

Mike T: I'm going with option 1 + 2. I've requested infra rollback and started the full cutover. Command used (routing UI/cli):
```
redwood-route set-policy --region eu-west --service embeddings-write --policy secondary-failover --apply
```

Lia M: status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-emb-write-euwest (note: mark as partial degradation).

Sarah L: notes for next shift: monitor these dashboards every 10m: `kv_io_latency`, `kv_write_error_rate`, `embeddings_regen_fail_pct`, `frontend_queue_length`. Also watch for customer retries and notify CS if regenerations exceed 5% for any single customer.

Avani R: customer impact breakdown we observed:
- 3 customers at high regen failure (~10-15%) due to sticky routing to old primary - CS notified them directly (see thread #customer-notify).
- ~12 customers saw transient errors (1-3%) during the spike.

Mike T: current mitigation state: full write cutover to secondary completed at 3478912360. Infra confirmed compaction rollback is in progress (INFRA-4521 updated). Backend errors decreased by ~80% within 90s, p99 embed latency dropped from 4.8s -> 1.9s for most tenants. Still seeing a few tail keys causing local spikes; I'm running `kv-prim-03` drain and targeted eviction for top 10 hot keys.

Josh P: if hot keys keep flaring, we should consider adding a short-lived hot-key admission control: `hotkey_penalty=0.5` for 10m. Runbook has snippet.

Mike T: applying targeted eviction now. Patch:
```
curl -X POST http://kv-prim-03.internal/admin/evict -d '{"keys": ["k123","k456"], "ttl": 60}'
```

Mike T: eviction success for top 6 keys, in-flight errors dropping. Monitoring.

Avani R: escalation path if this worsens: page infra on-call, open bridge, loop in Eng-ML lead and PM for customer comms. Pager contact: infra-oncall@redwood.ai, phone pinned in runbook.

Lia M: will post a short incident summary to #customer-notify after next 30m if stabilizes.

Sarah L: outstanding action items for next shift (Mike):
- Confirm INFRA-4521 rollback fully completes and record timestamp
- Verify cutover remains stable for 30m, then slowly failback if infra deems safe (do a canary to 5% traffic)
- Keep CS updated if any customer >5% regen failures
- If the SEV-1 threshold hits, open bridge and follow SEV playbook

Mike T: ack. I'll take primary. I'll post periodic updates every 15m.

Avani R: thanks team. Leaving detailed logs in ticket INFRA-4521 and internal incident doc. Handing off now. :thumbsup:

Mike T: thanks Avani. Taking over.

oncall-bot: Note: thread will be archived after 7 days of inactivity.
